name: Cardiff University

facts.text: Cardiff University is in the heart of Cardiff, the capital city of Wales.
The university has invested £600m in the biggest campus upgrade for a generation.
Cardiff University's Students' Union is consistently ranked among the best in the UK.
Cardiff University's current strategy is called 'Our future, together'.

sources.title: Visa information | Cardiff University International Study Centre (Study Group pathway provider)
topics: UKVI credibility interview with an Entry Clearance Officer
quotes: Why did you choose the Cardiff University International Study Centre?
Why do you want to study in the UK?
sources.notes: CAUTION: this is the International Study Centre (pathway college run with Study Group), not Cardiff University's own admissions; no page about a university-run pre-CAS interview for direct Cardiff University applicants was found. Verbatim: 'To help you prepare for a UKVI credibility interview and reduce your chances of a visa refusal, our UK Visa and Compliance Team conduct Readiness Checks.' 'If you have been identified as requiring a Readiness Check, then you must attend one before your CAS can be issued.' 'The purpose is for an Entry Clearance Officer (ECO) to establish that you are a genuine student.' 'Credibility interviews normally take place in your local Visa Application Centre, via a video link.' No CAS Shield mention. The related page https://isc.cardiff.ac.uk/next-steps was also fetched and only says 'Attend credibility interview: If required, participate in a visa interview to verify your intentions.' Cardiff University's own about page returned 403 to WebFetch and was read via the Browser pane.
